payout_quote: You, the Referrer, and the person you refer, the Referral, will both receive a $100 referral bonus if they use your unique referral code to open a new account and make an initial funding deposit of $1,000 or more within 60 days of opening their account.
steps: Be an existing tastytrade customer (individual, entity, joint, or trust account — IRAs excluded)
Get your unique referral link/code: web my.tastytrade.com > Manage > Summary > View Referral Link, or mobile app More > Settings > Referrals
Friend must open a new tastytrade account via your link/code before navigating away (or add the code within 60 days before funding)
Friend funds the account with at least $1,000 within 60 days of opening
$100 bonus deposited into your tastytrade account within 45 days of requirements being met; bonus can be traded immediately but withdrawn as cash only after the friend's 6-month holding period
catches: Friend must fund $1,000+ within 60 days AND the funding must stay in the account 6 months — your bonus cannot be withdrawn as cash before that holding period ends (though it is tradable immediately)
Cap: 24 referral bonuses per calendar year ($2,400 max)
IRAs excluded for both referrer and referee; referee must be a new US customer, 18+
If the friend clicks your link then navigates away before opening, the referral may not credit — they should open the account in the same session
Referral code must be applied before funding and within 60 days of account opening
Program has an end date (runs through 11/30/2026 per current terms) — verify still live before acting
biggest_catch: Your friend must deposit at least $1,000 within 60 days and keep it in the account for 6 months — your $100 is locked from cash withdrawal until that holding period ends.
eligibility: Existing tastytrade customers (non-IRA); referees must be new US customers 18+ with no prior tastytrade accounts
timing: $100 bonus deposited within 45 days of requirements being met; cash-withdrawable after the friend's 6-month funding hold
